description: Data analytics pipeline with strong cost optimization and balanced security/performance but poor reliability and sustainability

recommendations.title: How do you plan your network topology?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Implement multi-AZ architecture with redundant network paths and use AWS Transit Gateway for centralized routing.

recommendations.title: How do you design your workload to withstand component failures?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Implement circuit breakers, retry logic with exponential backoff, and graceful degradation patterns.

recommendations.title: How do you test reliability?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Implement chaos engineering practices using AWS Fault Injection Simulator and run regular game days.

recommendations.title: How do you select and use cloud resources in a way that reduces sustainability impact?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Use managed services, Graviton processors, and schedule non-production workloads to run only during business hours.

recommendations.title: How do you protect your data in transit?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Enforce TLS 1.2+ for all data in transit and use VPC endpoints for AWS service communication.

recommendations.title: How do you prepare for an event that affects availability?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Create and regularly test runbooks for common failure scenarios and implement automated incident response.

recommendations.title: How do you use compute resources efficiently?
recommendations.improvementPlan: Implement auto-scaling policies based on demand patterns and use Spot Instances for fault-tolerant batch processing.
